## Summary
Formal contract and integration test for the brainstorm-emit to preplanning-consume PIL handoff. SC13 fidelity checking (S9) requires a validated transport layer.

## Done Definitions
- Handoff contract document defines PIL schema at the brainstorm-preplanning boundary
- Integration test exercises the full brainstorm-emit -> preplanning-consume path
- Contract includes field-level validation: all PIL fields present and typed correctly
- Test runs end-to-end (brainstorm produces PIL, preplanning reads it without mutation)

## SC Coverage
SC13 (dependency — enables S9)

## Depends On
S8 (spec lexicon must be defined before handoff contract is written)

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
